scope: Explanation of expected historical runtime-summary hash differences noted in independent second reviews
purpose: The parent regenerates these working progress/coverage reports after each finished exploration work unit and delivery.
historical_snapshot_status: Earlier eligibility snapshots correctly retain the hashes at their own creation time. Those historic hashes are not rewritten to match later progress files.
frozen_evidence_status: Tested PNGs, plugins, predeclared design snapshots, exact requests, raw responses and original formal inputs remain frozen. Independent reviewers verified these separately.
authoritative_eligibility: Current branch dataset, original approval fingerprint and accepted/collected records are independently rechecked. A progress-report update does not record a user Pass or Collect.
not_a_permission_to_modify: No frozen test evidence, formal input, approval or existing user file may be changed. Future workers should classify mutable progress hashes as diagnostic metadata, not formal source fingerprints.
